author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Single-use wrapper does not add policy beyond the existing typed helper.
findings.consequence: The page has one extra local abstraction to inspect when following the empty-content fallback, with no behavior or boundary enforcement beyond `emptyRenderableHtml<AboutContent>()`.
findings.evidence: `emptyAboutContent()` only returns `emptyRenderableHtml<AboutContent>()` and is used once by the `aboutContent` computed fallback; the underlying helper already carries the renderable HTML capability type.
findings.recommendation: Inline `emptyRenderableHtml<AboutContent>()` at the fallback site, or replace the function with a shared constant only if multiple local fallbacks start needing the same value.
